bracketSpacing.description: Whether to print spaces between the brackets of object literals.

bracketSameLine.description: Whether to put the `>` of a multi-line HTML or JSX element at the end of the last line instead of alone on the next line.

vueIndentScriptAndStyle.description: Whether to indent the code inside the `<script>` and `<style>` tags of Vue files.

insertPragma.description: Whether to insert a `@format` comment at the top of formatted files.

requirePragma.description: Whether to only format the files that have a `@format` or `@prettier` comment at the top.

checkIgnorePragma.description: Whether to not format the files that have a `@noformat` or `@noprettier` comment at the top.

javascript.enabled.description: Whether to format JavaScript and JSX files.

typescript.enabled.description: Whether to format TypeScript and TSX files.

toml.enabled.description: Whether to format TOML files, which are formatted the way oxfmt formats them with every flavor.

parser.description: The parser of Prettier to read every file with, whatever its name. Example: `json5`. Not for the flavor "oxfmt".

plugins.description: The built-in implementations of Prettier plugins to use. They do not have to be installed.

importOrder.description: The order of the groups of imports, as regular expressions that the module specifiers are matched against, and special words like `<THIRD_PARTY_MODULES>`. Only with one of the two `prettier-plugin-sort-imports` in `plugins`.

importOrderParserPlugins.description: Accepted and not needed: TypeScript, JSX and decorators are read in every file.

importOrderSeparation.description: Whether to have an empty line between the groups of imports. Only with `@trivago/prettier-plugin-sort-imports` in `plugins`.

importOrderSortSpecifiers.description: Whether to sort the specifiers of an import. Only with `@trivago/prettier-plugin-sort-imports` in `plugins`.

importOrderGroupNamespaceSpecifiers.description: Whether to put the imports of a namespace at the top of their group. Only with `@trivago/prettier-plugin-sort-imports` in `plugins`.

importOrderCaseInsensitive.description: Whether to sort without regard to case. Only with `@trivago/prettier-plugin-sort-imports` in `plugins`.

importOrderSideEffects.description: Whether to sort the imports that are only for their side effects. Only with `@trivago/prettier-plugin-sort-imports` in `plugins`.

importOrderSortByLength.description: Whether to sort the imports by their length. Only with `@trivago/prettier-plugin-sort-imports` in `plugins`.

oneOf.description: Shorter imports first.

In alphabetical order instead of by length.

importOrderImportAttributesKeyword.description: The keyword that import attributes are written with. Only with `@trivago/prettier-plugin-sort-imports` in `plugins`.

importOrderExclude.description: Glob patterns of the files whose imports are left as they are. Only with `@trivago/prettier-plugin-sort-imports` in `plugins`.

importOrderTypeScriptVersion.description: The version of TypeScript of the project, which decides how the imports of types are written. Only with `@ianvs/prettier-plugin-sort-imports` in `plugins`.

importOrderCaseSensitive.description: Whether to sort with regard to case. Only with `@ianvs/prettier-plugin-sort-imports` in `plugins`.

importOrderSafeSideEffects.description: Patterns of the imports for side effects that can be sorted with the others. Only with `@ianvs/prettier-plugin-sort-imports` in `plugins`.

organizeImportsSkipDestructiveCodeAction.description: Whether to keep the imports that are not used. Only with `prettier-plugin-organize-imports` in `plugins`.

organizeImportsTypeOrder.description: Where the specifiers that are types are put among the others. Only with `prettier-plugin-organize-imports` in `plugins`.

oneOf.description: After the other specifiers.
Before the other specifiers.
Sorted together with the other specifiers.

tsconfig.jsx.description: The `jsx` of the `compilerOptions` of the project, which says whether JSX uses the import of `React`. The plugin cannot read the tsconfig.json itself. Only with `prettier-plugin-organize-imports` in `plugins`.

tsconfig.jsxFactory.description: The `jsxFactory` of the `compilerOptions` of the project. Only with `prettier-plugin-organize-imports` in `plugins`.

tsconfig.jsxFragmentFactory.description: The `jsxFragmentFactory` of the `compilerOptions` of the project. Only with `prettier-plugin-organize-imports` in `plugins`.

tsconfig.reactNamespace.description: The `reactNamespace` of the `compilerOptions` of the project. Only with `prettier-plugin-organize-imports` in `plugins`.

sortImports.description: Whether and how to sort imports the way oxfmt does, with the options that `sortImports` has in an `.oxfmtrc.json`. Only with the flavor "oxfmt".

sortPackageJson.description: Whether to sort the keys of `package.json` files. Only with the flavor "oxfmt".

sortScripts.description: Whether to sort the scripts as well.

jsdoc.description: Whether and how to format JSDoc comments, the way prettier-plugin-jsdoc does. Only with the flavor "oxfmt".

capitalizeDescriptions.description: Whether to make the first letter of a description a capital one.

commentLineStrategy.description: Whether a comment that fits on one line is written on one.

oneOf.description: Write a comment that fits on one line on one line.
Always write a comment on multiple lines.
Keep the comment on the lines it is written on.

separateTagGroups.description: Whether to have an empty line between tags of different kinds.

separateReturnsFromParam.description: Whether to have an empty line between the last `@param` and `@returns`.

bracketSpacing.description: Whether to write `{ string }` instead of `{string}`.

descriptionWithDot.description: Whether to end a description with a dot.

addDefaultToDescription.description: Whether to add "Default is `value`" to the description of a parameter with a default.

preferCodeFences.description: Whether to put code without a language between fences instead of indenting it.

lineWrappingStyle.description: How the lines of a description are wrapped.

descriptionTag.description: Whether to put the description after `@description`.

keepUnparsableExampleIndent.description: Whether an `@example` that cannot be parsed keeps its indentation.

insertFinalNewline.description: Whether to end a file with a line break. Only with the flavor "oxfmt".

packageSortOrder.description: The keys to put first in `package.json` files. Only with `prettier-plugin-packagejson` in `plugins`.
